title: Hearty {p} and {v} Chili
steps: Sauté the {v} in a Dutch oven with a little oil 5 minutes, until softened.
Stir in the {spice} and some garlic for a minute, until fragrant.
Add the {sauce}, 3 cups of vegetable broth and a cup of rinsed brown lentils. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 25 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the {p} (canned beans only need draining and rinsing; dried beans need soaking and boiling first) and simmer uncovered 10 to 15 minutes, until thick. Season with salt and pepper.
tip: Lentils and beans make this filling without meat. Serve it with a small piece of cornbread.
